name: terminal-pet
description: A cat in the empty prompt box that reacts to your day, with next-step suggestions beside it and /pet-stats silly stats

reportHour.title: Daily report hour
reportHour.description: Local hour (0-23) after which the day's silly stats pop up once. Set -1 to turn the pop-up off.

nextSteps.title: Next-step suggestions
nextSteps.description: After each answer, show up to 3 short follow-up prompts above the box, written by a small model call.
